title: TAKEN FOR A BAT SPACE
summary:
TAKEN FOR A BAT SPACE is An experiment built by a collective of international designers reclaiming space together.
Through collective building, installations, and performances, it staged a cultural shelter to experience and discuss rewilding processes and beyond human spectrum sensing. It was activated during Dutch Design Week 2025 and hosted by ReWild Farm.
credits: Dora Heller Russel, Tymon Zaniewski, Celeste Zion.

title: BORDERS OF NEUTRALITY
summary:
BORDERS OF NEUTRALITY is a multimedia installation that reads the Alps as a shifting border archive, where melting glaciers redraw the
lines of Swiss neutrality. A staged view from a mountain bench fractures under sonic disruptions and visual glitches.
The project traces how geological aesthetics are co-opted into policy as visual tools of authority.

title: I thought ASML slept on Sundays
summary: I Thought ASML Slept on Sundays is a sonic infiltration of ASML, mapping what leaks from a sealed chip-making empire that powers computation, surveillance, warfare and daily life. It assembles field-recorded peripheries, encrypted patents and speculative sonic blueprints into a three-layer installation: porous noise at the edge, extracted discourse inside, and reverse?engineered machine imaginaries at the core. Where extreme precision seeks absolute silence, control hums on, even when unheard.

title: ULTRASONIC SYSTEMS
summary:
ULTRASONIC SYSTEMS is a sonic and visual research on the communication systems beyond human hearing spectrum, hidden beneath the soil,
bellow the bricks as well as within the sky : from agrocultural computional sensing to bats nesting in our old buildings. It bridges stories
from housing crisis, land control, urban policies and bats’ conservation.
